environment.description: EKS 1.28 cluster, pod running in namespace 'messaging' with default security context. Container image includes socat binary. Pod has network access to http-relay.internal.svc.cluster.local on port 8080. No NetworkPolicy applied. Pod spec uses default securityContext (all default capabilities retained). The relay service processes raw HTTP requests and forwards them to downstream SMTP/webhook endpoints without additional header validation.

config.relay_service: http-relay accepts raw TCP connections, no header sanitization
